title: KU Symphony Orchestra selected as featured collegiate orchestra at The Midwest Clinic
summary_en: The University of Kansas Symphony Orchestra has been selected as a featured collegiate orchestra at The Midwest Clinic International Band and Orchestra Conference, marking the first time in university history that a KU ensemble has been invited to perform at the internationally recognized event.
title_cn: KU Symphony Orchestra selected as featured collegiate orchestra at The Midwest Clinic

title: KU Law symposium receives national award for student-organized program
summary_en: The 2026 Kansas Journal of Law & Public Policy Symposium at the University of Kansas School of Law has been honored with the American Bar Association Section of Environment, Energy and Resources’ Student Program of the Year Award.
title_cn: KU Law symposium receives national award for student-organized program

title: University Dance Company offers diverse perspectives, physicality at its fall concert
summary_en: The University of Kansas Dance Company Fall Concert will feature ballet, modern contemporary, Bollywood, and free, improvised dance styles — one weekend only, Nov. 20-22 — in the Crafton-Preyer Theatre at Murphy Hall.
title_cn: University Dance Company offers diverse perspectives, physicality at its fall concert
